olCorrection: Earlier wording "QB and OL cannot start before 2022" overstated OL: 2022 applies to the reference-backed route only.
withdrawn: The earlier conditional spans (OL 2000+, QB 2007+, receivers/RB 2000+, defense 2019+/2023+, common 2019+/2023+) are WITHDRAWN: they were inferred from release dates and missed the 17-game reference requirement, the FTN pressure-field contract and unverified component coverage.

qbIndex.why: season Y-1 must be a 17-game season (2021+) for a valid reference (B6)
qbIndex.status: NOT ASSERTABLE (B1); 2022 is a necessary lower bound only

referenceBacked.why: needs a valid 17-game season Y-1 reference (B6)

legacyFallback.why: not bounded by B6, but uses bundle ol.pressure_rate_allowed of season Y-1 (B1)

olIndex.status: NOT ASSERTABLE; 2022 bounds only the reference-backed route

receiverIndex.why: season Y-1 reference population needs B1 fields

defenseIndex.why: coverage and run-defense priors need B1; pass rush depends on the B4 replay policy; the PFR prior branch would need Y-1 >= 2018 and component coverage that is not verified

common.why: QB has no fallback and cannot start before 2022 (B6), which bounds any all-unit span; OL is not itself bounded by B6 (fallback route); all units remain blocked by B1

burnIn: Every unit needs season Y-1 inputs (prior and/or reference) and Y-1 must be a 17-game season for QB and for the reference-backed OL route (OL fallback route: B1-dependent instead); burn-in seasons are not display-eligible. Weeks 2-11 also need a verified Elo chain ending at Y-1.
